# StartupGraph

> The startup database built for AI agents. A graph of ~70,000 startups —
> funding rounds, headcount over time, leadership, news, and open-source
> activity — with a per-user research layer (lists, screens, notes, signals)
> designed to be written by agents and read by humans in an iPhone app.

## What you can do here

- Read the company graph with no authentication: REST API under /api.
- With a bearer token, use the MCP endpoint at POST /mcp (Streamable HTTP,
  JSON responses) to search companies AND write to your user's research
  layer: create lists, add companies with rationales, save research memos,
  create/refresh screens (saved queries with stored snapshots), and log
  signals to the feed.
- Humans get tokens with: php artisan api:token <email> --name=<agent-name>

## Key endpoints

- GET /api/stats — database statistics
- GET /api/search?q= — search companies and people
- GET /api/companies — list/filter companies (q, category, country,
  funded_after, funded_before, funded_recent=3m|6m|1y|2y, sort, order,
  per_page)
- GET /api/companies/{slug} — full company profile
- GET /api/companies/{slug}/funding | /people | /headcount
- GET /api/people/{slug} — person profile
- GET /api/oss-projects — open source projects
- GET /api/categories — valid category keys

Authenticated (Authorization: Bearer <token>):
- GET /api/me — identify the token
- GET|POST /api/lists, GET|DELETE /api/lists/{id},
  POST /api/lists/{id}/companies, DELETE /api/lists/{id}/companies/{slug}
- GET|POST /api/screens, GET|DELETE /api/screens/{id},
  POST /api/screens/{id}/refresh
- GET|POST /api/notes, DELETE /api/notes/{id}
- GET|POST /api/signals, POST /api/signals/{id}/read
- POST /mcp — MCP endpoint (initialize, tools/list, tools/call)

## MCP tools

Read: search_companies, get_company, get_stats, search_oss_projects.
Write (authenticated): create_list, add_to_list, save_note, create_screen,
refresh_screen, log_signal, list_my_research.

## Conventions

- All responses are JSON envelopes: { data, meta } (+ pagination on lists).
- Companies are addressed by slug everywhere.
- Writes record provenance (created_via = your token name).

## More

- OpenAPI spec: /openapi.yaml
- Source and contribution guide: https://github.com/dmorrill/startupgraph
